# Xuhong Bags - Full Site Context

Xuhong Bags manufactures custom bags for B2B buyers, including brand owners, retail teams, promotional product buyers, event organizers, schools and private-label sellers. The site is available in English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

## Languages
- English homepage: https://xuhongbags.com/en/
- Chinese homepage: https://xuhongbags.com/zh/
- Japanese homepage: https://xuhongbags.com/ja/
- Korean homepage: https://xuhongbags.com/ko/

## Product Categories
- Custom canvas tote bags: cotton canvas, recycled canvas, organic cotton, different fabric weights, custom colors, handles, gussets, pockets, zipper options, logo printing, embroidery and private-label packaging.
- Custom drawstring bags: cotton, polyester, nylon and non-woven drawstring bags for events, retail packaging, schools, sports, promotions and branded merchandise.
- Custom gift bags: custom retail and promotional gift bags with logo printing, private-label details, handles, labels, material selection and packaging support.
- Custom cosmetic bags: makeup pouches, toiletry bags and cosmetic organizers using canvas, PU, PVC, lining, zippers, handles and branded logo details.
- OEM bag manufacturer: OEM/ODM bag manufacturing for private-label brands, e-commerce sellers, promotional buyers and design-led projects.

## Manufacturing Workflow
1. Review artwork, dimensions, target use, material expectations and order quantity.
2. Recommend materials, logo process, structure, packaging and cost-sensitive options.
3. Produce a sample for material, stitching, size and logo confirmation.
4. Prepare materials and begin bulk production after sample approval.
5. Inspect production quality, pack goods and arrange export shipment.
